basic.name: Corpse Spiders
basic.description: Hurl a jar of spiders that deals 50~~0.04~~ damage. If it hits at least one enemy, create 3 Corpse Spiders that attack for 38~~0.04~~ damage. Spiders last for 4 seconds.

basic.name: Zombie Wall
basic.description: After 1 second, create a ring of Zombies surrounding the target area that deal 28~~0.04~~ damage and last for 3 seconds.

basic.name: Plague of Toads
basic.description:
Create a wave of 3 Toads that explode on contact, dealing 126~~0.04~~ damage over 6 seconds. This effect stacks.

Stores up to 2 charges.

heroic.name: Gargantuan
heroic.description: Summon a Gargantuan to guard an area, losing Health over 29 seconds. Deals 100~~0.04~~ damage when summoned, attacks for 140~~0.04~~ damage, and can be ordered to stomp nearby enemies. The Gargantuan's Stomp deals 240~~0.04~~ damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

heroic.name: Ravenous Spirit
heroic.description: Channel a Ravenous Spirit that deals 230~~0.04~~ damage per second. Cannot move while channeling. Lasts for 8 seconds.

heroic.name: Gargantuan Stomp
heroic.description: Order the Gargantuan to stomp, dealing 240~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

heroic.name: Gargantuan Stomp
heroic.description: Order the Gargantuan to stomp, dealing 240~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

trait.name: Voodoo Ritual
trait.description:
Nazeebo's Basic Attacks and Abilities poison Non-Heroic enemies, causing them to take 66~~0.04~~ additional damage over 6 seconds. 

Quest: If a Minion dies while poisoned by Voodoo Ritual, Nazeebo permanently gains 6 Health and 1 Mana.

activable.name: Ice Block
activable.description: Activate to place yourself in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds.

activable.name: Soul Harvest
activable.description: Activate to increase Nazeebo's Health and Spell Power by 7% for each nearby enemy, up to a maximum of 35%. Lasts 15 seconds.

activable.name: Bad Medicine
activable.description: Consume 5 stacks of Voodoo Ritual to become Unstoppable, gain 20% increased Movement Speed, and 50 Armor for 2 seconds.

level1.name: Widowmakers
level1.description:
Enemies hit by Corpse Spiders' jar are Slowed by 25% for 1 second.

Reward: After Corpse Spiders attack Heroes 100 times, their attack damage is increased by 25% and their duration is increased by 1 second.

level1.name: Pandemic
level1.description:
Quest: Hit Heroes with Plague of Toads.

Reward: After hitting 35 Heroes with Plague of Toads, it spawns 2 additional toads.

Reward: After hitting 70 Heroes with Plague of Toads, it reduces the damage Heroes deal by 5%, stacking up to 25%.

level1.name: Thing of the Deep
level1.description:
Increase the range of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 20%.

Reward: After gaining 50 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, gain 5% Spell Power.

Reward: After gaining 100 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, gain an additional 5% Spell Power.

level4.name: Hexed Crawlers
level4.description: Corpse Spiders restore 1% of Nazeebo's maximum Health and Mana when they attack an enemy Hero.

level4.name: Big Voodoo
level4.description: Increases the Health and Mana bonuses from Voodoo Ritual by 100%.

level4.name: Blood Ritual
level4.description:
If an enemy dies while poisoned by Voodoo Ritual, restore 2% of Nazeebo's maximum Health and Mana.

Passive: Takedowns grant 3 stacks of Voodoo Ritual.

level7.name: Spirit of Arachyr
level7.description: The number of Corpse Spiders spawned is increased from 3 to 4. If Corpse Spiders' jar hits only one enemy, it creates an additional spider.

level7.name: Dead Rush
level7.description: Zombie Wall deals 100% more damage. When it expires up to 5 remaining Zombies uproot and attack nearby enemies, losing Health over 3 seconds.

level7.name: Toads of Hugeness
level7.description: Increase the damage and explosion radius of Plague of Toads by 25% after each hop, up to a maximum of 100%.

level10.name: Gargantuan
level10.description: Summon a Gargantuan to guard an area, losing Health over 29 seconds. Deals 100~~0.04~~ damage when summoned, attacks for 140~~0.04~~ damage, and can be ordered to stomp nearby enemies. The Gargantuan's Stomp deals 240~~0.04~~ damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

level10.name: Ravenous Spirit
level10.description: Channel a Ravenous Spirit that deals 230~~0.04~~ damage per second. Cannot move while channeling. Lasts for 8 seconds.

level13.name: Guardian Toads
level13.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Plague of Toads grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, stacking up to 6 seconds.

level13.name: Superstition
level13.description: Gain 40 Spell Armor. Heroic Basic Attacks against Nazeebo remove this bonus for 3 seconds and spawn a Corpse Spider to attack the Hero.

level13.name: Ice Block
level13.description: Activate to place yourself in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds.

level16.name: Spider Colony
level16.description: Corpse Spider Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 0.125 seconds.

level16.name: Ring of Poison
level16.description: Zombie Wall lasts 1 second longer, and the center is filled with poison that deals a total of 319~~0.04~~ damage over 4 seconds. This damage starts small and increases over the duration.

level16.name: Soul Harvest
level16.description: Activate to increase Nazeebo's Health and Spell Power by 7% for each nearby enemy, up to a maximum of 35%. Lasts 15 seconds.

level20.name: Humongoid
level20.description:
Gargantuan Stomp's area is increased by 25% and its Slow amount is increased to 50%.

Passive: Reduce Gargantuan's cooldown by 40 seconds and its Mana cost by 50%.

level20.name: Annihilating Spirit
level20.description:
When Ravenous Spirit damages an enemy Hero, reduce their healing received by 50% for 1 second and increase Ravenous Spirit's damage by 5% for the rest of its duration.

Passive: Increases the range of Ravenous Spirit by 50%.

level20.name: Vile Infection
level20.description:
Quest: Reach 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual.

Reward: After reaching 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, it can also be applied to Heroes and its damage is increased from 66~~0.04~~ to 165~~0.04~~ over 6 seconds.

level20.name: Bad Medicine
level20.description: Consume 5 stacks of Voodoo Ritual to become Unstoppable, gain 20% increased Movement Speed, and 50 Armor for 2 seconds.
